rss.title: Meta shakes up the frontiers, open and closed
rss.text_excerpt:
This has been a week where the balance of American open-weight models took a step change back toward the frontier. Meta took the lead of this charge with Muse Spark Open , which is now the strongest American-made open model by quite some margin, but the addition of Reflection’s first model Beam is also relevant. Without these two models, there would be 20+ open-weight models built and released by Chinese companies better than the best Western models. At the time of writing this, Mistral has also announced a strong model, Mistral Large 4 , with an index score of 38 (see below), but its weights are not yet released. There are rumors of a few more strong American open-weight models coming from other organizations too! In many ways, the gap between the best American and Chinese models has been reduced roughly by half. We’ve gone from the best American open models being largely irrelevant to consumers who require the cutting edge of performance, to them being behind but relevant. This paints the picture of the cut-throat, competitive nature of the frontier model business. Reflection and Mistral announced their model scores and Meta dropped the weights of a smarter model before these other two labs could get their own weights out. All of these models are competing with Chinese models released months ago, where the industry is collectively asking — where have Kimi and Zhipu AI been since the releases of GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3 on Aug. 18th and Jul. 16th, respectively? That is a very nuanced question, which I’ll dig into another time. Today’s piece is focused on Meta’s turnaround, what Muse Spark Open means for the ecosystem, and the balance of power across Western frontier labs. rss.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
rss.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.
rss.text_excerpt:
Creating a close, personalized experience for millions of customers in a country like Brazil is, first and foremost, a question of simplicity rather than of models. “Much of it is about making something simple, direct, and useful, delivering a direct benefit to the customer, and making the technology almost unnoticeable,” says Carlos Eduardo Mazzei, CTO of Itaú. The standard he describes is demanding: the solution must solve a real everyday problem and be direct, simple, and memorable. Technology serves as the means, never as the centerpiece of the experience. There is demand for this. A study by Itaú in partnership with Grupo Consumoteca shows that 80% of Brazilians want to better organize their financial lives and seek more effective support for decisions, and that 65% would like technologies that act as a financial copilot, providing ongoing guidance. “OpenAI’s models were very important in delivering this experience, because they were able to operate across this range of solutions.” —Carlos Eduardo Mazzei, CTO, Itaú The journey began in 2024, when the bank introduced the first Inteligência Itaú capabilities for specific financial needs. ia.i is the next stage: a complete conversational layer, activated by text or voice, bringing interactions related to checking accounts, credit, cards, insurance, and other services into one environment — and connecting customers to specialized human support whenever needed. This breadth was precisely what guided the choice of models. “OpenAI’s models were very important in delivering this experience, because they were able to operate across this range of solutions,” Mazzei explains. “From the simplest ones, which need to be efficient in cost and latency, to more complex solutions, where reasoning and all the necessary grounding are required to provide an appropriate answer.” Having a range of models — rather than a single model — made it possible to deliver the complete solution in one product. At the center of this experience is Customer DNA, a layer of financial context that helps the bank understand the needs, habits, and life stages of approximately 70 million customers. # Why Macro We built Macro because we wanted a single operating system for our startup. There are many good software products, and we used them all — Slack, Linear, Notion, HubSpot, and Superhuman — but they don't work together as one system. As we scaled our last venture to ~20 people things started to break: every team got their own tools and the company was held together by MCP and Zapier. The company was not computable. It was chaotic. Macro is a complete redesign of work software from the ground up as a single system. Designed by us in NYC and Toronto, dogfooded by our team of ~15 for two years. Built in SolidJS and Rust for speed and reliability. We're focused on building something that any small company or team at a larger company can use as their "operating system".

It fronts any number of inference backends (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, or any of [81 providers](docs/providers.md)) behind one address: **0.76 µs of work per request**, no I/O on the request path, and response bodies that are never parsed. It reads LiteLLM-format config files unchanged, so it drops into an existing setup without rewriting anything. ## Quick start ```bash git clone https://github.com/azrtydxb/Fastllm-proxy && cd Fastllm-proxy docker compose up -d docker compose exec fastllm fastllm-proxy set-password --name you --password 'change-me' ``` Clients point at `:4000`; the management UI is at `https://localhost:4001/`. [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) walks from here to a served request. ## Why it is fast, and stays fast **No I/O on the request path.** RBAC, rate limits and budgets are integer comparisons against a snapshot flattened in memory. `tests/no_io_on_hot_path.rs` fails the build if that stops being true. **No parsing on the response path.** Upstream frames reach the client exactly as they arrived. A gateway that deserialises each SSE chunk to re-emit it does thousands of parse/re-encode cycles per second per stream; this one does none, so the cost does not grow with how much your users read. **Cache-affinity routing.** vLLM and SGLang keep a radix/prefix KV cache, so two requests sharing a system prompt are far cheaper on the _same_ node. Round-robin alternates them by construction — nodes look evenly loaded while aggregate throughput drops. A shared prefix goes back to the node already holding its cache, unless that node is meaningfully hotter than the least-loaded one. **Highly available on purpose.** A proxy that loses its control plane keeps serving from its last snapshot. # InferenceX Dashboard / InferenceX 仪表板
**English** | [中文](./README_zh.md)
A [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) dashboard for visualizing ML inference benchmark data. DB-backed with Neon PostgreSQL, React Query for data fetching, D3.js for interactive charts. **Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS 4 · shadcn/ui · D3.js · Neon PostgreSQL · Vercel · Cypress ## Overview LLM inference performance is a major concern of providing AI services, but accurate performance analysis remains elusive. Fast cadence of software development and model releases makes comparing performance between setups difficult. Existing performance benchmarks quickly become obsolete due to being static, and participants game the benchmarks with unrealistic, highly specific configurations. InferenceX tackles these issues by benchmarking popular models on major hardware platforms nightly with the latest software. For each model and hardware combination, InferenceX sweeps through different tensor parallel sizes and max concurrent requests, showing the throughput vs. latency graph for the full picture. In terms of software configurations, we ensure they are generally applicable across different serving scenarios, and we open source the repo to welcome community contributions. We hope InferenceX informs the community up-to-date and realistic LLM inference performance. ## Architecture ``` Neon PostgreSQL → API routes (/api/v1/*) → React Query hooks → Context providers → D3.js charts ``` The frontend fetches data from API routes backed by a Neon PostgreSQL read replica. All presentation logic lives in the frontend — API routes return raw DB data. 感谢IT之家网友 有鲫雪狐 的线索投递！ IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，今日，商务部、科技部发布 2026 年第 48 号公告，就修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》（以下简称《目录》）公开征求意见，并对相关技术实施出口前登记的临时管理措施。日前，商务部新闻发言人就有关问题回答了记者提问。IT之家整理商务部原文如下： 问：《目录》修订的背景是什么？ 答：根据《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》第二十条，国务院对外贸易主管部门会同国务院其他有关部门，制定、调整并发布禁止或限制出口的技术目录。自 2001 年以来，商务部会同科技部多次调整修订《目录》，有进有出，有管有放，已形成工作惯例。此次修订亦是技术贸易管理的常态化工作，依法依规进行，不针对任何特定国家、地区或实体。 近年来，人工智能、生物医药和光伏相关技术在敏感领域的应用不断拓展，各主要经济体均实施了不同程度的出口管控。中国参考国际通行做法，依法实施必要的管理，既防范技术失控和不当扩散风险，也保障正常国际技术交流合作，推动科技向上向善、安全可控、造福人类。 问：《目录》拟新增技术的范围有哪些？ 答：此次公开征求意见涉及拟增列的人工智能、生物医药、光伏三个领域 40 项关键技术。其中，拟禁止出口技术 14 项，包括：人工智能驱动的恶意代码生成与变异技术、具有自主知识产权的细胞和基因治疗技术工艺平台、钙钛矿及叠层电池组件生产技术等；拟限制出口技术 26 项，包括：人工智能辅助漏洞挖掘技术、具有自主知识产权的通用型细胞和基因治疗全新靶点发现和验证技术、单线产能≥3 万吨 / 年的多晶硅工程技术等。公告还明确了适用便利措施等情形。详情请参考公告原文。 问：《目录》修订是否充分考虑产业发展情况？ 答：中国政府一贯支持企业依法依规开展互利共赢的跨国经营与国际技术合作，有关政策立场没有改变。针对此次公开征求意见的技术范围和政策，商务部、科技部会同行业主管部门，事前已广泛组织研究机构、行业组织开展深入评估，并充分听取主要企业的意见建议，充分考虑国内外产业现状和发展需求。具体表现在三个方面：一是列管范围精准有限。此次拟列管的多数技术已明确具体技术指标，且利用相关技术制造的产品不在管理范围内，管理范围清晰、精准、有限，为企业划定了合规边界，便于政策执行。二是适用便利措施。此次列管明确了拟适用便利措施的多种出口情形，体现了分级分类的管理理念，有助于增强政策的透明度和可预期性，确保技术出口安全、规范、有序。三是实施动态调整。商务部、科技部将依法对《目录》管理范围实施动态调整，根据技术发展情况，及时将不先进或落后技术移出《目录》。此次征求意见是在更大范围内听取各方意见建议的工作安排。 问：对于拟增列的人工智能技术，主要有哪些考虑？ 答：当前，全球人工智能技术创新进入前所未有的活跃期，机遇与挑战并存。此次拟将人工智能大模型、智能体、算力集群、信息处理相关 23 项关键技术增列至《目录》，主要有以下考虑： 一是确保人工智能技术安全可控。人工智能引发的各类内生和衍生风险已引起全球各国的高度关注。此次拟列管的人工智能自主驱动恶意代码生成与变异技术等，可被用于攻击国家关键信息基础设施、国防军工、核心政务等敏感系统，或用于绕过国家安全防御体系。若被非国家行为体或恶意实体获取，可能对国家安全和人类共同安全造成危害。中国政府对这类技术实施必要管理，目的是筑牢安全底线，防范滥用恶用，确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下，推进人工智能国际治理。 二是鼓励开源开放、合作共享。中国政府致力于让人工智能成为促进共同繁荣、维护共同安全的一个重要动力源。为支持构建人工智能开源创新生态体系，对人工智能类技术开源、中国企业在境外自建自营算力中心、赴境外开展芯片流片制造、利用境外资源开展联合研发、参与国际标准制定等情形的技术出口，适用自动许可等便利措施，基本实现“即报即出”；对已通过开源、发表学术论文等方式进入公共领域的相关技术，拟不纳入出口管理范围，为人工智能技术国际交流合作创造良好环境。 需要特别指出的是，中方主张在相互尊重、平等互利基础上，与各国开展人工智能对话合作，共同应对人工智能技术扩散和失控风险。中方支持全球南方国家加强人工智能能力建设，弥合数智鸿沟，促进可持续发展。对于世界人工智能合作组织成员间开展能力建设国际合作、技术共享和规则共建所需的技术出口，将提供更多便利和支持。 问：《目录》正式实施后，人工智能大模型在海外本地化部署、向境外提供模型调用等各类“出海”形式，是否属于技术出口管理范围？ 答：当前，人工智能大模型和应用产品的“出海”模式多种多样，判别具体“出海”情形是否属于技术出口管理的范围，核心在于是否涉及限制类技术从中国境内向境外转移。 此次纳入监管的人工智能技术范围精准有限，有关措施正式实施后，绝大部分人工智能技术仍可以自由出口。对于纳入限制类的人工智能技术，开展海外本地化部署，属于技术出口管理范围；如果部署在海外自有云等风险相对可控的情形下，可适用自动许可等便利措施。对于企业利用限制类大模型对外提供 API 调用、APP / 网页交互、SaaS 应用、本地端侧轻量化部署等情形，不属于大模型技术出口管理范围。 aihot.title: 丹麦最高法院裁定持有传播 AI 生成儿童色情内容可判实刑
aihot.summary: 据彭博社 15 日报道，丹麦最高法院维持对一名 31 岁男子 18 个月监禁的判决，该男子因持有并传播 3.6 万余张 AI 生成的儿童色情图像获刑，且不适用缓刑。法院裁定，即使图像无真实人物原型，也受丹麦《刑法》约束，量刑时不应考虑人物是否虚构；此案为丹麦首起此类定罪，并引发跨国调查，警方查明 273 名买家身份、逮捕 25 人。
aihot.text_excerpt: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，据彭博社 15 日报道，丹麦最高法院维持对一名 31 岁男子判处的 18 个月监禁刑罚。该男子因 持有并传播数万张 AI 生成的儿童色情图像 而获刑。 这起备受关注的案件，涉及丹麦现行打击儿童性虐待影像的法律如何适用于 AI 合成内容。该国最高法院裁定， 即使 AI 生成的未成年人色情图像没有真实人物作为原型，也同样受到丹麦《刑法》约束 ，不能因为图像中的人物是虚构的就减轻刑罚。此前，两级下级法院对本案的量刑存在分歧。 判决指出，对于持有和传播描绘未满 18 岁者的色情材料，在量刑时不应考虑图像中的人物是否被认为是虚构的。 据IT之家了解，该男子被判处的 18 个月监禁不适用缓刑。 这是丹麦首起因制作和传播 AI 生成的儿童性虐待影像而定罪的案件，最高法院也借此首次明确了此类犯罪在丹麦法律下的量刑原则。 涉案男子曾利用 AI 制作超过 3.6 万张逼真的儿童色情图像，并通过网站和聊天频道传播。法庭文件显示，他还通过订阅服务出售部分图像，至少赚取 2.5 万丹麦克朗 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 24,801 元人民币） 。 警方 2023 年底突击搜查其住所时，男子 28 岁。他承认制作和传播图像的行为，但认为这些图像 并非以真人为原型 ，因此不应受到有关刑法条款的处罚。 去年，此案还引发了一场跨国警方行动，调查对象包括数百名购买这些图像的人。警方根据支付记录查明 273 人的身份，并在世界各地逮捕 25 人。 丹麦两级下级法院均认为，即使图像完全由 AI 合成，只要足够逼真，也可以依据现行打击儿童性虐待影像的法律追究刑事责任。但两级法院在具体量刑上存在明显分歧。 2025 年 1 月，地方法院 判处其 15 个月监禁 ，但允许大部分刑期缓期执行，理由之一是没有证据表明 AI 模型曾使用真实的儿童性虐待影像进行训练。同年晚些时候，高等法院改判 18 个月实刑，理由是 涉案图像数量庞大、传播活动有组织地开展，且部分图像被用于牟利 。

aihot.title: 消息称投资者下调 Anthropic IPO 估值预期，从约 2 万亿美元降至约 1.5 万亿美元
aihot.summary: 路透社援引知情人士消息称，Anthropic 公布最新财务数据后，部分投资者开始考虑下调其 IPO 估值，此前预期 11 月上市时估值约 2 万亿美元，投资者日活动讨论约 1.5 万亿美元。
aihot.text_excerpt: 感谢IT之家网友 火瓶座 的线索投递！ IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，北京时间今天（16 日）凌晨，路透社援引四名知情人士消息称，随着 AI 融资成本持续攀升引发市场担忧，Anthropic 公布最新财务数据后，部分现有投资者和准备参与 IPO 的投资者 开始考虑下调对 Anthropic 的估值 。 其中三名知情人士称，部分投资者参加了 Anthropic 在旧金山举办的投资者日活动，并讨论了约 1.5 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 10.05 万亿元人民币） 的估值。此前，投资者预计 Anthropic 在 11 月上市时的估值 约为 2 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 13.41 万亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 向潜在投资者披露，第三季度营收达到 168 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,126.1 亿元人民币） ，环比增长 45%，并在调整部分财务项目后实现盈利。 业绩数据缓解了部分投资者对 AI 研发成本高昂的担忧的同时，营收增速放缓 仍令一些投资者失望。 Anthropic 第二季度营收达到 116 亿美元 （现汇率约合 777.55 亿元人民币） ，比第一季度增长一倍以上，第三季度的环比增幅则降至 45%。 Anthropic 上市后的市场反响也可能影响整个 AI 行业的前景。投资者认为，短期内 AI 市场的表现很大程度上取决于 Anthropic 能否顺利上市，以及随后 OpenAI 能否在明年上市。 投资者对 Anthropic 估值的顾虑，恰逢全球金融市场遭遇 科技股抛售潮 ，AI 基础设施企业、芯片制造商，以及向 AI 企业出租算力的新兴云服务商均受到冲击。获得英伟达投资的 CoreWeave 周四股价和债券价格大跌，反映出市场越来越担忧 AI 基础设施建设对债务融资的依赖。 如果 Anthropic 上市表现不佳，投资者对 AI 基础设施投资热潮的担忧可能进一步加深。 此前消息称，Anthropic 在 2025 年的营收增至前一年的约 12 倍，接近 46 亿美元 （现汇率约合 308.34 亿元人民币） ，但剔除主要由此前融资引起的负债减记影响后，经营亏损仍超过 80 亿美元 （现汇率约合 536.24 亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 的招股说明书提出，AI 对全球经济的影响将超过工业化、电力和互联网带来的变革。Anthropic 同时披露，2025 年亏损 420 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,815.25 亿元人民币） ，并预计未来建设 AI 基础设施还需要投入更多资金。
